phase: Confirmation of the selected public procedure on fresh seeds. Frozen before generation; results do not change the procedure.

procedure.call: wade.wade(counts, cond, direction='both', scale='linear', pvalues='auto', relative_error=0.2, normalization=RLE fit on the complete matrix, test_genes=wade.filter_counts(counts, min_count=3, min_samples=2), seed=permutation_seed); counts carry seeded Uniform(0, 1) jitter; the mean test is the saddlepoint unless its error estimate exceeds relative_error, then shuffled

comparator: Two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum per gene (asymptotic, tie-corrected) on the same normalized counts and test mask; one BH family over the tested genes, as for WADE; a call's side is the sign of U - n1*n0/2
null: Independent biological patients; exposures independent of condition; no injected group confounding

generator.retired: bulk_half_subset_up_10pct_4x: below the information limit (2026-09-27 review); replaced by the 8-1024x raised-subset series

endpoints.calibration: Per matrix: mean calls (q <= alpha; side = sign of mean_log2fc) on unaltered genes (background and shared-tail nulls) over all mean calls; complete-null any-call rate
endpoints.power: Share of each profile x abundance called with its intended side, and with the other side, over all replicates
endpoints.direction_errors: Up calls on bulk_down_two_thirds and down calls on bulk_up_1.5x
endpoints.subset_calibration: Per matrix: subset calls (subset q <= alpha) on genes in no_subset over all subset calls
endpoints.subset_power: Share of each planted-subset profile x abundance with a subset call on each side
